result:
Perfect! All tests now pass. 

**Summary:**
The bug was in the `discount()` method in `/tmp/tacet-bench.sDalgS/project/tally/invoice.py` (line 42). The condition checked `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` but the comment clearly states "Orders of **at least** this many units get BULK_PERCENT off", meaning it should be `>=` instead of `>`.

The test `test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units` was failing because with exactly 10 units, the condition `10 > 10` evaluated to False and no discount was applied. Changing it to `>=` fixes the issue.
